title: Birdsville Courthouse
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap way 1026090385, tagged with Birdsville Courthouse and Wikidata Q28035357, identifies the articulated roof over the standing building near Adelaide and Macdonald Streets. This outline controls the location and orientation of the original court and attached residence.
sectionBasis: The archive photograph depicts the prominent corrugated roof, sandstone masonry, a projecting gable, shaded verandah posts and chimney. Written field documentation describes the eastern courtroom’s hipped roof, the residence and veranda enclosures, and the courthouse masonry. Dated council condition material records limewash, a southern gable and chimney. Texture and non-visible details are estimated.

dimensions.roofProjections: East hipped courtroom, transverse gable, lower west residential roof and verandahs.

limitations: The circa-1925 photograph establishes persistent roof, post and masonry features. Later enclosures use the written heritage description and the current mapped roof perimeter.
The pale limewash represents the surveyed historical treatment. Present shades, enclosure openings, joinery and exact heights are estimated.
The separate lockup and Aboriginal tracker’s hut are outside the mapped courthouse model. An original open terrain field is sampled without sculpting.
